el.¿Qué es el Instructorado en Yoga Esencia: What is the Instructorado en Yoga Esencial?
el.Es una formación anual de Yoga de seis m: It's a six-month annual Yoga training, online and live, that explores the history and philosophy of Yoga, the chakra system, asanas, pranayamas, meditation, and the pedagogy of teaching a class.
el.¿Necesito formación previa?: Do I need any previous training?
el.No. Se empieza desde cero. Alcanza con t: No. You start from scratch. All you need is a practice of your own and a desire to study.
